summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of EventPro MVP. Backend: 41/43 pytest tests passed (95.3%); 2 failures are test-side artifacts (lowercased email, recomputed reviews_count) — not real bugs. All critical APIs (auth, vendors, bookings, payments mock, reviews, favorites, chat, AI/gpt-5.2, KYC, vendor dashboard, services, availability, role guards) work correctly. Frontend: Customer login → home with hero/event-types/categories/trending vendors works; vendor detail (About/Reviews/Gallery), Book Now → booking form, My Bookings list with COMPLETED+PAID badges, AI chat (gpt-5.2 reply received), vendor login → dashboard with all tiles, vendor bookings inbox with Accept/Reject/Chat, KYC form — all working. Razorpay is correctly in mock mode (PAYMENT_MODE=mock); /api/payments/order returns mock order_id and /api/payments/verify marks booking paid/confirmed. AI uses Emergent Universal Key with gpt-5.2 successfully. No React Native red screen, no deprecated packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) detected. Minor RN Web warnings (shadow* / pointerEvents deprecations) and Expo version-mismatch warnings (expo 54.0.34 vs 54.0.35) are non-blocking.

minor.issue: Email is silently lowercased on registration — UX OK but undocumented; consider normalizing on input/preserving original casing in response.

POST /api/reviews recomputes reviews_count to len(db.reviews) which overwrites the seeded random reviews_count (e.g. 45 → 1). Seeded counts are decorative-only; once a real review is added they drop. Not a bug but inconsistent UX. Consider also persisting an initial baseline or using $inc instead of len().
Mock mode — intentional for MVP. Confirmed end-to-end mock flow works.

issues: React Native Web console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic only; doesn't affect native build but noisy in web preview.

react_native_issues.issue: Minor Expo package mismatch warnings on every Metro boot — expo@54.0.34 (expected 54.0.35), expo-font@14.0.11 (expected 14.0.12), expo-router@6.0.23 (expected 6.0.24). Reference: /app/frontend/package.json. Non-breaking but should be aligned with `npx expo install --check`.

action_items: (Optional) Align Expo package versions to satisfy `npx expo install --check` — run `yarn expo install expo@~54.0.35 expo-font@~14.0.12 expo-router@~6.0.24`.
(Optional) Replace deprecated RN Web style props: use `boxShadow` instead of `shadow*` and `style.pointerEvents` instead of `pointerEvents` prop to silence warnings.
(Optional) Reconsider /api/reviews recompute logic — using $inc on reviews_count and incremental rating avg would prevent the seeded count drop when first real review is added.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: 724 lines — borderline; consider splitting into routers (auth, vendors, bookings, payments, chat, ai, vendor_self) for maintainability.

server.py: bcrypt warning in logs ('AttributeError: module bcrypt has no attribute __about__') is a passlib+bcrypt compatibility quirk. Functionally OK (hashing works), but pin bcrypt<4 or upgrade passlib to silence.
server.py: PATCH /api/bookings/{bid}/status uses query param `status_val` rather than JSON body — uncommon REST style; works but body-based update would be more conventional.
server.py L42: OAuth2PasswordBearer uses `auto_error=False` but get_current_user raises 401 manually — consistent and fine.
All MongoDB queries correctly exclude `_id` via projection. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified (login, home, vendor detail, booking form, bookings list, AI chat, vendor dashboard, vendor bookings inbox, KYC)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 20 Indian vendors across Hyderabad/Mumbai/Delhi/Bangalore, 3 combos, vendor1-20 admin accounts (Vendor@123), and customer.demo@eventpro.in/Demo@123 on first boot. Tests created a few TEST_* users, 1 booking (then completed + paid), 1 review, 1 KYC submission, 1 service — all prefixed appropriately.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_eventpro_api.py is reusable. Use customer.demo@eventpro.in/Demo@123 and vendor1@eventpro.in/Vendor@123. Frontend testIDs used: login-email, login-password, login-submit, ai-input, ai-send, logout-button (label is 'Sign Out'). Mock payment flow: POST /api/payments/order returns order_mock_*; verify accepts any signature. AI gpt-5.2 reply can take ~10-20s; the UI shows 'Thinking…' state.
rca_of_issue: No critical issues found. The two pytest failures are test-side artifacts: (1) test compared 'TEST_cust_*' to lowercased response — server correctly lowercases emails on register; (2) reviews_count comparison expected `+1` from seeded baseline but server recomputes to actual db.reviews count. Both are expected backend behaviors.
